Also mentioned saw some blood in stool last few days, concerned b/c of the anticoagulation meds. Denies fever or severe pain. Caregiver wondered if this is normal and whether need to adjust the medication or get labs done. Mentioned pt is still working part time and managing. Also mentioned new grandchild, very excited about that. I instructed caregiver to contact surgeon's office and also reach out to PCP to discuss the bleeding and bruising, may need INR check. Advised to monitor and call 911 if any signs of severe bleeding or chest pain. VM left for surgeon regarding anticoagulation concerns and need for labs.
Called pt at 1430 today, no answer. VM left requesting callback at pt's earliest convenience re post-op status.

Pt called back at 1645. States doing okay overall, incision healing well denies increased pain or drainage. Mentioned weather has been nice finally, couple family visiting from out of state which is good. Also mentioned some persistent shoulder tightness been bothering him but unrelated to surgery. Re diet - pt having significant difficulty w/ the advancement plan given at d/c. Started soft foods as recommended but having nausea and some bloating when trying to add regular consistency foods, tolerating clear liquids and broth okay but apprehensive about progressing further. Denies vomiting, bowel function normal. Pt c/o mild stomach cramping when attempting to eat per protocol. Suggested staying on current tolerance level, encouraged frequent small meals PRN and will notify surgeon's office regarding diet intolerance s/p laminectomy. Will ROV in 3-5 days to reassess feeding tolerance. Pt receptive to plan.

Pt c/o via telephone today, 85 days post lumbar laminectomy. Reports doing as well as can be expected but expressed significant concern re: upcoming ortho follow-up appt. Stated he is still unable to sit upright for more than 10-15 min due to ongoing pain & stiffness, remains primarily bed-bound, cannot transfer into/out of regular car seat. Wife on vacation next week so transport a real issue. Pt explicitly stated this is NOT about whether insurance covers anything or cost—he physically cannot get into a regular vehicle, needs either wheelchair van w/ stretcher capability or ambulance to make it to clinic. No medical transport currently arranged. PT denies having explored options yet, says didn't know how to set that up. Mentioned weather's been nice finally, asked how I'm doing, complained briefly about new neighbor's dog barking but then refocused on transport problem. Reassured pt that we can help coordinate appropriate transport & will follow up w/ him by EOB tomorrow w/ specific contacts. Will also reach out to ortho clinic to flag that pt will need modified arrangements for appt. Pt seemed relieved, said "ok great, just needed to talk to someone about this."

pt called today, 13d s/p DC. c/o ongoing nausea, denies vomiting but reports feeling sick to stomach especially in AM. states started noticing 3-4d ago, denies related to diet or meds, denies fever/abd pain. advised to f/u w PCP if persists beyond 48h, given antiemetic PRN instructions, pt willing to monitor.
VM left 10/15 requesting pt call back re: post-DC follow-up scheduling. No response to VM.

Pt called in. S/p colectomy 66d ago, no post-DC surgical f/u appt has been scheduled. Pt c/o significant tiredness and weakness since d/c, reports difficulty w/ activity tolerance, not improving. Denies fever, infection s/x. Instructed pt to contact surgeon's office today to schedule eval, reinforced importance of post-op visit. Pt verbalized understanding. Will attempt f/u call in 1 week if no appt confirmation ROV.

POD#7 f/u call, pt called in reporting feeling like heart racing and skipping beats x2 days, describes as irregular and fast, denies CP/SOB/dizziness, VM left w pt to call MD today if continues and d/c given 24hr call line. Advised to seek urgent care if worsens.

Called pt's daughter at home. Pt s/p colectomy 44d ago. Has f/u appt scheduled but daughter states pt unable to make it at that time - pt's mobility very limited and daughter unsure how they'll get him there. Clarified appt date/time w/ daughter, advised to contact surgeon's office to reschedule. Daughter receptive, will call office tomorrow. No other acute c/o at this time.

Pt called today, 5d s/p cholecystectomy. Doing okay otherwise, incision healing up fine. She was telling me about how cold it's been and her granddaughter visiting next month. Asked how she's doing with eating and pain, says pain controlled on ibuprofen mainly, only took the oxycodone couple times. But then mentioned she hasn't had a BM since surgery and is getting worried about it, tried some prune juice yesterday no luck. Denies straining or pain with attempts to pass stool, just nothing coming out. Has been up and moving around the house which is good. Told her this is pretty common after surgery especially with the pain meds she was on, encouraged fluids and mentioned stool softener, she said she'd pick some up at the pharmacy. VM left for her surgeon's office to double check if anything else needed, patient comfortable waiting to hear back. Will follow up in 2-3 days.

Pt called c/o persistent nausea x 3-4 wks, denies vomiting, no clear trigger, states unrelated to s/p cholecystectomy 86 days ago. Also reported has Rx for new med but hasn't started taking it yet, unclear on reason, discussed importance of starting per MD orders. Pt receptive to education, will restart today. VM left for MD re: nausea.
Called home phone at 10:15am, no answer. VM left requesting pt or caregiver to call back at their earliest convenience. ROV.

Caregiver called back at 2:40pm. Pt is 11d s/p discharge. Caregiver reports pt has been feeling sick to stomach since yesterday morning, having difficulty keeping food down, denies abd pain or fever. States nausea worse in am, does eat some lunch and dinner but small amounts. Denies recent changes to meds. No vomiting witnessed by caregiver but pt states feeling like he might throw up. Advised caregiver to monitor I&Os, encouraged fluids, called in PRN phenergan. Instructed to call PCP if symptoms worsen or persist beyond 24-48hrs.

Pt c/o never received results from recent labs/imaging post s/p appendectomy. Called to follow up 61d post-D/C, states waiting on pathology/imaging report not yet communicated by surgery clinic. Advised to contact surgeon's office today for clarification.

POC with daughter, pt doing well overall. Daughter reports noticing some bruising on pt's arms and legs over past few days, denies trauma but concerned given pt on coumadin. Pt also c/o some oozing from gums when brushing teeth x2 days. Counseled daughter re: monitoring for increased bruising or bleeding, advised to contact MD if worsening or any concerning signs. INR check due this week, will VM pt when results back.

Pt called today, 6 days s/p hernia repair. Reports ongoing n/v since discharge, worse w/ food. States vomiting small amount yesterday morning, denies abd pain or fever. Tolerating sips of fluids. Not taking home meds as instructed d/t nausea. Advised pt to call surgeon if worsens or unable to keep down fluids, may need IV rehydration.
Pt called w/ question re: wound care instructions - states MD said to keep dressing dry but PT told her to wash area daily. Clarified plan per MD, pt verbalized understanding.

Pt called by caregiver today POD#14 s/p lumbar laminectomy. C/o persistent lower back pain at incision site, reports pain not adequately controlled w/ current regimen of prescribed analgesics. Denies fever, wound drainage, or spreading symptoms. Pain localized to surgical area, does not radiate. Discussed importance of taking meds on schedule vs PRN only; caregiver VM to set phone reminders. RTC w/ surgeon if pain worsens or if unable to achieve relief w/in 48hrs.
Called pt residence at 1430, no answer VM. Left message requesting callback today.

Spoke w/ pt's daughter. Pt doing okay overall but c/o persistent nausea since d/c 14d ago, especially after meals, likely residual from anesthesia. Also reports he has not received results from labs drawn prior to discharge - daughter called surgeon's office multiple times but told results were "sent to pt" though nothing arrived. Pt denies vomiting, tolerating small meals and fluids. Advised to contact surgeon's office directly to request hard copy and will also note in chart for nursing to follow up s/p call.

Pt called re: 37d s/p hysterectomy. Reports unable to arrange reliable transportation to required tx appts 2-3x/wk - has means to pay but logistics of getting there repeatedly is barrier. Denies financial issue. Concern is coordinating multiple trips weekly.

Pt's daughter called. Pt having episodes of feeling like the room is spinning when he stands up too fast, happened twice last week. Says he gets lightheaded & one time almost fell in the bathroom but caught himself on the counter. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or falls. Denies any recent medication changes. Advised to rise slowly, increase fluid intake, call MD if episodes continue or worsen. Daughter will monitor and watch for any falls.

POD#9 s/p cholecystectomy. Pt's caregiver called c/o pt unable to tolerate diet advancement. Started advancing diet per post-op protocol but pt having trouble w/ solid foods, experiencing nausea & bloating w/ attempts to eat regular meals. Currently able to tolerate fluids & soft diet only. Denies fever, drainage, or acute abdominal pain. Advised caregiver to hold advancement at current level, increase fluids, resume clear diet x 2-3d. Will RTC PRN if symptoms worsen or call surgeon's office for VM.
Pt c/o no way to get to scheduled appt - no car, no one able to drive him, denies transportation $ issue, states transit not available in his area. Time of appt not a problem.

Spoke w/ caregiver for 45yo pt s/p appendectomy 17d ago. Caregiver reports pt c/o pain at incision site not relieved w/ current pain regimen. Pt taking prescribed pain meds PRN but states pain continues throughout day. Caregiver denies fever, drainage, or other wound concerns. Advised caregiver to contact surgeon given uncontrolled incisional pain and discussed need for VM to surgeon's office.

POD #2 phone f/u. Caregiver called on pt's behalf. Pt c/o confusion regarding what's safe to eat and drink post-dc. Caregiver reports pt asking what foods/liquids are okay now and seems uncertain about restrictions. Counseled on gradual advancement of diet per d/c instructions, advised to refer to written summary. Pt to call if worsening symptoms or if diet q's not answered by VM or ROV chart.

Pt called c/o incisional pain 5 days s/p cholecystectomy. Denies fever, denies nausea. Pain localized to surgical site, not controlled on current regimen of ibuprofen 400mg q6h PRN and acetaminophen. Pt reports pain level 7/10 with activity, 5/10 at rest. Advised to contact surgeon if pain worsens or if any signs of infection develop. VM left for surgeon regarding inadequate pain control.
VM left 10/15 at 1430, pt not available. Call back requested.

Pt reached on callback. States having chills and feeling very hot since yesterday evening, temp checked at 101.2. Denies cough, denies CP, taking ibuprofen q4-6h PRN. Advised to contact PCP and consider ED if symptoms worsen or persists >24h.

POD#10 call to caregiver for routine f/u. Pt reports confusion regarding activity restrictions and lifting limits post-discharge. States unsure if driving is permitted or what level of activity is safe at this time. Caregiver unable to clarify from d/c paperwork. Discussed need to review dc instructions and contact PCP for detailed restrictions. Pt denies new c/c or complications since d/c.
VM left 2/15 at 1415h asking pt/caregiver to call back re: post-d/c f/u, no ROV by end of shift

Called back today, spoke w/ daughter who is primary caregiver, pt in background. Daughter mentioned it's been crazy at home with the weather being so bad and they've had furnace issues on top of everything else, joked that this winter won't quit. Pt doing okay physically she says, no new pain really but some stiffness when he first gets up in morning, says he's been trying to stretch like PT told him. Daughter brought up the weights and BP checks that supposed to happen daily - said honestly they haven't been doing that, got busy with work stuff and just kinda fell off, she apologized. Asked when last check was, she said maybe two weeks ago? Pt also c/o some fatigue and daughter mentioned he's been sleeping more than usual, wondered if that was normal. Denies fevers, denies new leg pain or weakness, no signs of infection s/p surgery. Does have some knee issues from old injury but that's unrelated. Going to restart the weights and BP monitoring tomorrow, daughter very agreeable to setting phone reminder. Instructed caregiver on importance of daily readings given surgical history, will try to call back in 1 wk to confirm compliance. Pt on current pain meds PRN, only taking occasionally. No other acute c/o at this time

Pt called today 38d s/p hysterectomy, sounding well overall. Nice to hear from her, told me the weather's been beautiful where she is. Pt c/o bruising on her abdomen and inner thighs, says it's been there about 2 wks now and doesn't seem to be getting any better, wonders if that's normal. Also mentioned she had some vaginal bleeding yesterday, just a bit, stopped after a few hours, denies ongoing drainage or foul smell. We reviewed her anticoag meds - she's still on lovenox as prescribed, taking it exactly as directed, no missed doses. She wanted to know if the bruising and that one episode of bleeding could be from the shots, seems worried about it. Mentioned her grandson is visiting next week which she's excited about, then circled back to ask how long before she should expect the bruising to completely resolve. No acute pain, no fever, denies lightheadedness. Advised pt to continue lovenox, discussed bruising can persist but needs VNA eval for bleeding episode given anticoag use. Will notify provider re: yesterday's vaginal bleed for further direction.

Pt c/o unable to reach surgeon's office after discharge 8d ago, tried multiple times & kept getting VM, finally got through to answering svc who said need to wait for call back but still hasn't heard anything. Also tried to reach PCP for refill on BP med but office staff said would need referral from surgeon first. Called specialist office yesterday & got same runaround. Pt getting frustrated, says weather's been nice though so at least been able to sit outside. Mentioned his daughter's been helping with stuff around house. Denies increased pain or fever, incision looks ok per pt, but wants to know about some swelling that started couple days ago & can't get anyone on phone to ask. Will attempt to contact surgeon's office on our end, advised pt to also try early morning calls. VM left requesting return contact.

Pt called today d/p discharge. C/o difficulty arranging rides to outpatient treatment 3x/week. States has funds to pay for services but the main barrier is getting transportation sorted out consistently, not cost. Says managing at home OK but nervous about getting to appts regularly. Advised pt to call case mgmt for community resources and ride programs. RTC if unable to arrange.
VM left 0900 re: post-d/c f/u, pt called back 1430

Pt c/o unable to set up CPAP mask and adjust straps, also having difficulty holding walker steady when ambulating. Instructed on proper mask placement, recommended ROV video demonstration and suggested contacting DME company for walker height adjustment. Pt verbalized understanding, agreed to call back if further issues.

Pt called today, 7d post-DC. Sounding better than last week, said the weather's been crazy, we laughed about that. Asked how he was doing w/ meals and he said honestly the diet stuff is tough - can't find much at the grocery store that fits what the nutritionist told him to eat, says most of what they tell you to get is expensive and not really available where he shops. Mentioned his sister's visiting from out of state which is nice. He's been trying to stick w/ it but keeps running into the problem that he doesn't have good options, sometimes just grabs what's there b/c he's hungry and nothing else works. Denies pain, incision healing okay, no fever, taking meds as prescribed. Main thing coming through is the frustration w/ food access - he wants to do the right thing but it's just not there for him practically speaking. Told him I'd loop back w/ nutrition and social work, may need resources or different approach. Will VM RN nutritionist today and circle back to pt by tomorrow.

Pt called today 13d s/p d/c, doing ok overall, says weather has been nice and grandson visiting this week which is good. Mentioned blood pressure running a bit high at home but denies any chest pain or SOB. Main issue is pt unable to pick up one of discharge rx due to insurance company needing prior auth approval before they'll cover it, pt states he called pharmacy twice and they told him insurance is holding it up and they're waiting to hear back. Pt not sure which medication exactly but thinks it's one of the new ones started in hospital. Explained I would follow up with pharmacy and case mgmt to see status of PA, advised pt to call if symptoms change or has any concerns. VMed case mgmt to flag this issue.

POD 15 s/p colectomy, caregiver called w/ concerns. Pt reports increased abd bloating and cramping when trying to advance diet as instructed. States tolerating sips only, denies BMs x 3 days. Tried soft foods yesterday per post-op plan, pt c/o significant discomfort and nausea, reverted to clear liquids. Instructed caregiver to hold diet advancement pending MD contact, offered PRN supportive measures.

Pt called today, 62d s/p hysterectomy. Doing well overall, no c/o of pain or bleeding, denies fever. Weather finally getting nice she said, been stuck inside too much. Has follow-up appt scheduled w/ surgeon but called to say she can't make it that day bc daughter is having car trouble and pt committed to helping her out, thinks maybe next month might work better. Mentioned her knees have been bothering her lately, prob just arthritis, but asked if we could look at that too when she reschedules. Incision healing fine per pt, no drainage or redness noted by her. VM left for surgical clinic to see if can move appt to different time, pt will wait to hear back. Encouraged to call back if any issues arise before then.

pt called to check in, 12d s/p lumbar laminectomy, doing well overall per pt report. discussed how recovery progressing, pt mentioned weather been pretty nice for this time of year. asked about incision site care and pt states there's been some redness around the incision, feels warm to touch, and there's drainage that looks kinda yellow or greenish coming from it, pretty wet. pt denies fever but hasn't checked temp. also mentioned his daughter just had her baby which is exciting but also means wife is helping with grandkids so can't help much at home. pt c/o some generalized back pain which is expected but incision site being warm and draining is concerning so i advised pt to call surgeon or go to ED if drainage worsens or if he develops fever or chills. pt lives about 20 min from hospital. also pt denies any other new complaints besides the site and the usual ache, moving around better than first few days home, still sleeping propped up on couch mostly. will have pt follow up with surgeon this week, advised to keep wound covered and clean per discharge instructions.
Pt called by VM to ROV s/p d/c. States he doesn't have $ for PT copay right now, can't get to appts w/o transportation help & that's not covered. Discussed financial resources, pt aware of options.
VM left 0930 requesting callback re post-op status, pt called back 1145.

Pt c/o new onset abd pain x 2-3 days, describes as crampy mid-abd, denies nausea/vomiting, denies change in bowel habits or recent GI sx. Pt states not related to surgical site and began after d/c s/p lumbar laminectomy 48d ago. Pain 5/10, worse w/ certain positions, better w/ rest. Denies fever, chills. Encouraged pt to f/u w/ PCP, discussed ROV to ED if worsening or development of vomiting. Pt agree w/ plan.
Called pt at 2:15 PM, VM left asking to call back at convenience regarding post-op check-in.

Pt called back 3:45 PM, 21 days s/p hernia repair. C/o incisional pain that is not improving w/ current regimen of acetaminophen and ibuprofen PRN. Pain localized to operative site, describes as dull ache that worsens w/ activity. Denies fever, drainage, or redness. States pain is limiting daily function. Advised pt to contact surgeon's office for eval if pain persists or worsens, gave after-hours number.

Called pt's daughter today, 40d s/p hysterectomy. Daughter reports pt received Rx but insurance holding medication pending prior auth from MD office, unclear when this will be resolved. Separately, pt not doing daily weights or BP checks at home as prescribed - daughter states they have not been doing this since discharge. Reinforced importance of monitoring given recent surgery. Instructed daughter to contact MD office re: prior auth status on medication and to begin daily weights/BP monitoring today.
POD#6 f/u call, pt states haven't received any visits yet from nursing agency, denies contact from VNA or home health to schedule.
Pt called in, spoke to patient directly. 11d s/p lumbar laminectomy.

Pt c/o incision at surgical site opening up, sutures coming apart. States wound looks like it's separating. Also reports unable to afford follow-up visit and copay at this time. Advised to contact surgeon's office re: wound concern, discussed payment options available. Pt to call back if worsens or unable to reach surgeon.
Pt called post-discharge day 10 c/o ongoing pain not controlled despite adherence to prescribed regimen, denies localization to incision site.
called 1000 VM left requesting callback. ROV 1015.

pt called back 1020 s/p total knee arthroplasty 3d ago. c/o redness and warmth around knee incision. pt states area also has weeping drainage that looks yellowish. denies fever. instructed to monitor closely PRN ice elevation. advised to contact surgeon if worsening or if purulent drainage increases.
VM left requesting pt to call back re: post-d/c FU appt scheduled for next week. ROV.

Pt called back today, 55d s/p cholecystectomy. States has appt scheduled but can't make it as planned - not sure if able to get ride or if conflict w/ schedule. Pt unclear on details. Discussed keeping appt, pt says will try to work it out and call office back if needs to reschedule. No acute c/o, denies fever/chills/abd pain. Denies N/V. Incision healing well per pt.

Pt called f/u post hernia repair x41d. Reports rec'd rx from pharmacy but hasn't started yet. States unsure about timing/dosing & wanted to talk to nurse b4 taking. Advised pt to review paperwork & call back if questions, can also reach MD office. ROV instruction sheet sent to pt s/p discharge.

Pt called today, 39d s/p CABG. Reports feeling well, energy improving slowly but steadily. Denies c/o chest pain, SOB, or palpitations. Wound healing well, no erythema or drainage noted per pt report. Ambulating around home, tolerating activity as instructed. Denies any concerns at this time, states he is managing well with current medications. Plan: continue current regimen, will ROV in 2 weeks if needed.
VM left on pt cell, call back ROV. Spoke w/ pt today.

84M POD#9 s/p colectomy reports no BM since d/c, having difficulty w/ bowel movement. Denies pain. Currently on opioids for post-op discomfort. Instructed on bowel regimen, encouraged PO fluids & activity, will fol up in 2-3d or sooner if worsens.
Called pt's home 1445, no answer. VM left requesting return call. Caregiver called back 1620.

Spoke w/ caregiver for 85yo pt s/p hernia repair 49d ago. Advised to contact prescriber re: med clarity and will follow up w/ DME vendor and call caregiver back by EOD tomorrow.
called by daughter, pt c/o unable to sit up or transfer from bed, needs stretcher/ambulance transport to appts but none arranged, daughter states not a coverage issue-they just need transport set up

Called by pt's daughter today d/p 19 days s/p lumbar laminectomy. Reports pt c/o incision coming apart at site - states sutures appear to be separating and there is small amount of drainage. VM left 11/14 @ 1430h re: post-op follow-up call. Pt called back @ 1545h same day.

Pt 38d s/p lumbar laminectomy doing well c/o minimal residual pain managed w/ OTC meds. States unable to fill gabapentin Rx d/t cost - insurance not covering & out of pocket too expensive. Currently stretching what he has by taking every other day rather than prescribed dosing. Explained importance of pain control & ROM exercises. Provided info on pharmacy discount programs & pt to contact PCP re: formulary alternatives or PA options. Pt states will attempt to call PCP office next week. ROV as needed.
VM left 0945 requesting pt/caregiver call back re: f/u appt.

Caregiver ROV, states pt has urology appt scheduled next Tues but cannot make time due to pt's existing medical appts that day c/o physical therapy & oncology consult already booked. Caregiver asking if appt can be rescheduled to different day. Pt denies transportation barriers. Will contact urology clinic to coordinate scheduling options.

Pt called today POD10. C/o ongoing abd pain, describes as crampy, intermittent, mostly lower abdomen. Denies n/v, no change in bowel habits. Pain started approx 5d ago, not related to prior discharge dx. OTC antacid PRN minimal relief. Advised pt to monitor, increase fluids, call back if worsens or develops fever. VM left for PCP referral.

RN called pt for post-d/c f/u s/p CABG 46 days ago. Pt 85+ yo, doing well overall, denies new c/o. Advised pt to hold docs and contact billing to clarify. Call completed without clinical concerns identified.

Called pt's caregiver at home 37d s/p appendectomy. Pt c/o n/v x several days, denies abdominal pain or fever. Caregiver unsure if related to surgical recovery or new onset. Tolerating PO but reports episodes 2-3x/day, worse in PM. Advised VM to surgical team for eval, reassess in 2d.

Pt called regarding post-op q's re: restrictions on lifting, driving & activity levels. States unsure what is/isn't allowed at this time post-colectomy. called pt home, no answer, VM left requesting pt call back during business hrs re: post-op f/u

pt called back. 8wks s/p hysterectomy. c/o feeling "really worn out" and having trouble getting around the house, says she tires easily w/ minimal activity. denies fever, increased pain, abnormal bleeding. states she's not back to baseline yet and frustrated she can't do much. encouraged to continue gradual activity as tolerated, advised to notify MD if symptoms worsen. VM left for pt at end of call w/ instructions to reach out if new concerns arise.

Called pt's daughter this AM POD#1. Caregiver reports no one has shown up yet from the nursing agency. Pt is home & stable but daughter concerned about timing of VN services that were supposed to start. VM left w/ agency to inquire on status of scheduling. Will follow up tomorrow.

Called caregiver 61d post TKA. Pt has meds at home but not started on them yet—caregiver states pt concerned about taking PRN before "ready" & wants to see how knee progresses w/o. Encouraged adherence, reinforce importance, caregiver to discuss w pt.
Called home 2:15 PM, caregiver answered, pt not available at moment, left VM requesting callback at earliest convenience

Caregiver called back around 4 PM, said pt doing okay overall, back pain manageable with the PT exercises, though complaining a bit about the weather being so humid and aggravating the stiffness. Pt called d/p CABG x5d. C/o pain at sternotomy site, states incisional discomfort not relieved w/ current regimen of scheduled analgesics. Denies fever, drainage, or wound changes. VM left for covering surgeon regarding inadequate pain control at surgical site.

Pt called today 57 d/p CABG. Reports increased SOB over past 2 weeks, occurring with minimal activity like walking around house, also notices it at rest. Denies CP, denies leg swelling. VM left 1420 asking pt to call back re: post-d/c follow-up appt scheduled.

Pt called back. States she has appt with gyn on 3/15 but "can't make it work" - says getting there is going to be difficult. Denies any c/o post-hysterectomy. Pt somewhat vague on what the barrier is exactly. Advised to call office directly to reschedule if needed or discuss options. ROV.

Called pt's daughter at work per discharge instructions. Pt c/o persistent dizziness x 3d started day after beginning metoprolol. Denies vertigo, lightheadedness only, worse w/ position changes. Called pt residence at 1400, caregiver answered, states pt resting, asked to call back in 30 min. VM left with request for ROV.

Caregiver c/o pt has not started new cardiac med prescribed at discharge. Pt waited 3 days for Rx, called pharmacy yesterday, told no Rx on file from our facility. Pt denies s/s of concern pending med availability. RN to verify Rx transmission from discharge.

Pt called c/o persistent pain in abdomen. States taking pain med regimen as prescribed but pain not improving. Denies localized incision tenderness or drainage. 85yo s/p hysterectomy 76d ago. Instructed to contact surgeon for eval. VM left for surgeon's office.

Pt called back 12/16 1100h. States has not heard from specialty clinic & no appt scheduled yet despite DC paperwork given at hospital. VM left requesting pt callback re post-op follow-up. Pt called back approx 1 hr later.

Pt c/o lower abd pain x several weeks. States pain is constant, rates 5-6/10, worse w/ activity. Denies fever, drainage, redness. Advised to call PCP for eval, instructed to seek urgent care if fever develops or pain acutely worsens. Will follow up in 1 week PRN sooner.
VM left 2/14 at 1:47p re f/u post-op call, requested pt contact us back. Daughter called back today 2/15 at 10:20a.

Spoke w daughter who is primary caregiver for pt. Pt doing well overall, says incision healing nicely and pain well controlled on tylenol PRN, not needing the stronger stuff anymore which is good. Caregiver called s/p d/c from cholecystectomy POD51, reports pt unable to fill current Rx pending insurance approval; awaiting prior auth from carrier.

Spoke w/ daughter of pt today, 2 days post-d/c. VM left 1/15 at 1430, pt's caregiver to call back when available for f/u post-op s/p hysterectomy. No callbacks received prior to today's contact.

Pt called reporting increased incisional tenderness on POD#4 s/p CABG, states pain 7/10 at sternum and left leg harvest site not well controlled w/ current regimen of oxycodone q4-6h PRN. Pt called back. Cards follow-up appt scheduled 1/22 @ 10am but pt states unable to attend that time - has standing commitment every Tues morning caring for adult grandson, can't be away from home. Post-d/c f/u call 47 days s/p hysterectomy. Spoke w/ caregiver (pt c/o pain w/ activity). Pt called 71d s/p chol, having trouble checking BS readings and unsure if numbers make sense when he does get them. VM left w/ instructions to contact MD or call us back if readings remain unclear.

Pt's daughter called to check in 7d s/p appendectomy. States pt c/o discomfort at incision site, rates as dull and achy, worse when moving around or coughing. Going to follow up with surgeon at scheduled appt next week, will VM if any concerns before then.

Pt called d/c on POD8 s/p colectomy. C/o having trouble getting up from chair & moving around house like expected at this point. States legs feel weak & painful when standing. Pt c/o pain at incision site not adequately controlled on current PRN regimen, states pain 6-7/10 at rest and worsens w/ movement. Pt called for f/u post-op d/c. States incision healing well, denies fever or drainage. Reports insurance approved the antibiotic script but copay was manageable. VM left 1430 today requesting pt call back with med questions. PT called back 1605.

PT called to clarify post-op meds. States unsure of dose, frequency and timing on one of discharge Rx. Pt c/o confusion about when to take it and how much. Advised to contact pharmacy and check discharge paperwork, will follow up ROV if not resolved. PT to also review instructions w/ wife.

pt called with questions, doing ok overall he said but wife mentioned it's been pretty cold out there this week, anyway pt c/o some uncertainty about what he's supposed to be doing w/ the bandage on his leg since dc 14 days ago. went over dressing change instructions from dc paperwork, pt stated he wasn't really clear on how to take off the old one or what to use to clean the wound or if it's ok to get water on it, also asked if he should be putting anything on it before putting new bandage on. denies fever denies increased pain but admits he hasn't looked at the wound much bc he said it makes him uncomfortable, his daughter lives nearby and has been helping but she had to go back to work last week so pt's been trying to figure it out himself. reinstructed on gentle cleaning w/ NS, pat dry, and application of new sterile dressing, emphasized importance of keeping it clean and dry and to call if any signs of infection or increased drainage. pt verbalized some understanding, wrote it down on a piece of paper, said he'd talk to his daughter about helping again bc he's nervous about doing it wrong, also asked about the rain coming this weekend which apparently affects his knee pain. encouraged to follow up w/ surgeon in 2 wks as scheduled and to call office w/ any concerns before then.
Attempted contact 1300h, no answer. VM left requesting pt call back today.

Pt called back 1430h POD18 s/p hysterectomy. C/O drainage from pelvic drain still present & copious, soaking through dressing multiple times daily. Denies fever, denies foul odor, incision intact. ROV to OB clinic scheduled for tomorrow. Will call back if increased output or signs of infection develop.
VM left 1430 requesting callback. Pt's caregiver answered attempt #2 at 1505.

Caregiver reports pt s/p hernia repair doing well overall but has not had bowel movement since d/c 15d ago. No straining or difficulty passing stool, just nothing moving. RTC if worsening or unable to achieve BM within 2-3d.

Called pt's daughter at home, pt doing ok overall, daughter reports weather has been quite cold this week. Pt's daughter called for post-d/c f/u on POD#7. Daughter confirmed cost not issue and insurance all set, main problem is repeating transportation several times per week. Pt's daughter called on behalf of mother, 11d post-d/c. Pt doing well overall, denies new symptoms, c/o mild knee pain but states this is chronic and not worsening. No other active issues noted during call.

Pt called by, s/p appendectomy 60d ago. C/o unable to sit upright or transfer independently, bed-bound at home. Denies this is coverage issue - states no medical transport arranged & needs wheelchair van or stretcher transport set up to attend f/u care, nothing currently in place.

85yo pt called pt-initiated on POD14 s/p dc. Unsure of dose/frequency on current med and reports got different instructions from provider and SW re: same med - unclear which guidance to follow. Instructed pt to call clinic Monday for clarification before taking next dose.

Pt called this AM for f/u post-op day 71 s/p hysterectomy. Been managing OK overall, daughter doing well is at college now, weather has been nice here in the Northeast finally. Taking them regularly, not PRN, exactly as prescribed post-d/c. Pt states the pain is more of a deep generalized ache rather than sharp incisional pain. Seems frustrated that it's not resolved by now. Recommended she call her surgeon's office for eval given timing and persistence. Will try to reach surgeon's office to give them VM with update. ROV to pt next week if hasn't heard from surgeon.

Called pt's daughter this morning, she's been his main contact. Mentioned it's been quite cold out there, she said yes been freezing past few days. Called by pt's daughter today, 8d post-d/c. Pt has cardiology f/u appt scheduled for next week but cannot make it due to conflicting work schedule. Pt called w/ concern regarding f/u appt already scheduled. States having difficulty w/ transportation logistics at this time & unclear if able to make it on day/time currently booked. POD#4 call to caregiver. Pt reports has been taking home meds as prescribed since disch but ran out of new Rx given at discharge. 55d post-op lumbar laminectomy. Pt c/o doing well overall. Has Rx on hand but states has not started taking as prescribed - still deciding if needs it. Encouraged compliance, discussed importance. VM left for MD callback if questions.
Attempted contact 1430 - pt did not answer, VM left asking pt to call back regarding f/u post-discharge.

Pt reached by phone today, 67d s/p hernia repair. States cannot sit upright or transfer independently - essentially bedbound at this time. Pt c/o unable to tolerate diet advancement s/p appendectomy, having difficulty w/ solid foods, mostly tolerating liquids only. Instructed to resume clear liquids x 24hrs, will reassess. Pt verbalized understanding, will call back if worsens.

PT called today 35d s/p lumbar laminectomy. Reports doing well overall, denies fever, infection c/o, or neurologic changes. VM left 10/15 2pm re: post-op f/u TKA, pt to call back.
Pt c/o increased SOB x 5 days, present at rest and with activity. Denies CP, denies fever. VM and ROV planned.

Pt called reporting upset stomach and couple episodes of throwing up since got home Tuesday late afternoon. Pt called to follow up post-discharge d/8. Has filled rx but has not started taking it yet. States uncertain about the regimen and wants to clarify dosing schedule before beginning. Pt called today 83d s/p colectomy doing well overall but c/o heart palpitations x several weeks. VM left for cardio clinic. Pt verbalized understanding.

Pt called reporting ongoing sharp pain in lower abd x 2-3 weeks, not at incision site. Denies recent fall, trauma, or change in bowel habits. Pain described as coming and going, worse w/ activity. Son-in-law maybe visiting this weekend pt says, though might get rained out. Instructed pt to call 911 if any chest pain or difficulty breathing, otherwise wait for my call.
Pt called for f/u post colectomy, 89d post-d/c. Stated does not want to continue with phone calls, asked to be removed from follow-up program.

Pt called to confirm f/u appt scheduled for 3 days from now. POD#9 call to caregiver re: pt 70yo. Reassured caregiver this is being flagged for RN eval. Will f/u per protocol.

Unable to reach pt on first attempt 8/12 at 1430h, VM left requesting ROV.

Pt called back today. S/p discharge 8 d ago. States that visiting nurse never showed up and he has not received any supplies for his wound. Denies knowing who to call to set this up. Instructed pt to contact case management today and provided number. Pt verbalized understanding.
Pt called re: DME ordered prior to DC not yet rec'd, states equipment also not functioning properly when arrived. VM left w/ DME supplier re: replacement/delivery status.

POD#10 - Caregiver called on behalf of pt. States pt has not rec'd appt info or call from clinic since d/c. Pt denies knowing who to contact or what next steps are. Post-d/c call d/1. Pt c/o difficulty obtaining foods that fit w/ prescribed diet at home, states groceries don't have what she needs.
Unable to reach pt on first attempt, VM left requesting callback.
Pt called back 14d post-d/c. Unsure how many times per day to take one of home meds and when exactly to take it - will review med list and clarify dosing w/ pt, pharmacy to contact pt directly.

Pt c/o persistent discomfort since d/c 40d ago s/p hysterectomy. Taking prescribed pain regimen as directed but reports inadequate relief. Pain described as generalized, not localized to incision site. Incision healing appropriately per pt. Discussed need for f/u w/ surgeon to assess etiology.

Pt called c/o question re: insurance coverage for DME ordered at discharge. Denies other symptoms or concerns. Advised to contact insurer directly w/ Rx and discharge paperwork to verify coverage and any prior auth req. Pt verbalized understanding. ROV w/ team re: coverage status.

Pt called today d/c POD#1. C/o anxious about discharge labs - states told prior to leaving hospital that results would be called but has not heard back. pt called, reports has appt scheduled but no way to get there - no car, no one available to drive him, transit not option in his area. denies financial issue, not asking about coverage. says time of appt is fine, issue is getting there.

Pt called this AM, doing reasonably well post-op day 6 s/p hysterectomy. Weather's been nice here so that helped her mood. POD 11 s/p CABG. Caregiver c/o pt reports incision pulling apart, staples coming loose at sternum. Denies fever, chills, purulent drainage at this time. Pt called to report pain level persistent despite adhering to prescribed analgesic regimen q4-6h. Denies incision site concerns or localized drainage. Pain diffuse, not tied to surgical area. pt's caregiver called, reports pt having episodes of lightheadedness and feeling like she might pass out, occurred several times over past few wks, denies falls but states pt feels dizzy when standing up quickly

Pt called today for f/u post-op appendectomy at 79d. Reports c/o chills and feeling hot over past 2 weeks, denies checking temp at home. pt called c/o nausea x 2 days, denies vomiting. states symptoms started yesterday AM, occurring intermittently throughout day. denies fever, denies diarrhea. taking zofran PRN as prescribed. pt unclear if related to recent colectomy or something else he ate. instructed to continue current regimen and contact office if worsens or develops vomiting. Pt called asking about sx post-op, unable to reach surgeon office - VM left, no ROV yet. Also unable to reach PCP's office, specialist phone lines going to VM. Pt called this AM, spoke w/ pt directly. Alert and oriented, states healing well overall but having trouble managing pain around knee incision site despite taking prescribed meds as directed. pt called today, 11d s/p d/c. confused re: one of current meds - unsure of dosage, how often to take it, and when during the day. pt states was discharged w/ paperwork but cannot locate med list. instructed pt to check discharge summary or contact pharmacy.
